note: Plan rebuilt for the machines at Anytime Fitness Mound. Bench starts from your Oct 17 session (135×8 ≈ 170 max). Big lifts: stop 1–2 reps short. Machines and cables: work in the rep range, last set to failure. When every set hits the top of the range, add weight.

day1.note: Test day. Warm up 135×3, 155×2, 170×1, then go for 185. Use a spotter.
